desc: Implement helper `sumExtremum(nums, k, isMin)`: monotonic stack for PSE/NSE boundaries with correct tie-breaking (strict on one side, non-strict on the other), then O(1) clamped pair-count per index via arithmetic-series split.
Implement `minMaxSubarraySum` as sumMin + sumMax (max via mirrored comparator), with `from typing import List` import.
Independently verify: manual brute-force cross-check on small arrays with duplicates ([2,2], k=2 → 12; [1,2,2], k=2 → 17) confirming tie-handling and the pair-counting formula.
Test edge cases: k=1 (answer = 2×sum(nums)) and k=n (reduces to classic sum-of-subarray-extremes formula) — both verified algebraically.
Clean up dead code in right pass and confirm O(n) time / O(n) space, suitable for n=80000.
